Definition
[$L^p$ spaces] 1. ch7:7.3–7.4\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0157 For $1\leq p<\infty $, let $L^p(\Omega )$ be the space of measurable functions with finite norm \begin{equation} \tag {7.3} \| u\| _{p;\Omega }=\| u\| _{L^p(\Omega )} =\left(\int _\Omega |u|^p\, dx\right)^{1/p}. \end{equation} For vector- or matrix-valued $u$, $|u|$ is the Euclidean norm. Define \begin{equation} \tag {7.4} \| u\| _{\infty ;\Omega }=\| u\| _{L^\infty (\Omega )} =\operatorname *{ess\, sup}_\Omega |u|. \end{equation} The domain subscript is omitted when it is clear.
